description: Expected outcomes for each demo objective. The frontend compares actual transfer results against these to show PASS/FAIL.

O1.label: Does the file arrive intact?
O1.pass_criteria: SHA-256 hashes match and zero retransmissions

O2.label: Does the checksum detect damaged chunks?
O2.pass_criteria: All corrupted chunks detected (retransmissions > 0) and final file verified

O3.label: Can Hamming fix 1-bit errors without re-sending?
O3.pass_criteria: Zero retransmissions, bits corrected > 0, and file verified

O4.label: Checksum vs CRC32: which detects more?
O4.pass_criteria: Checksum misses at least one word-swap corruption; CRC32 detects all or nearly all
